title: Remove selected elements, smooth layout, and add visible Terms & Policy link

requirements.text: Remove the scroll-to-top button (SVG icon and its anchor wrapper) identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1]/svg[1] and /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] — this is the floating scroll-to-top anchor element in the page layout.

quotes: Jo Jo select Kiya hai in sabko Remove kar do

acceptanceCriteria: The scroll-to-top button/anchor is no longer rendered anywhere on the page
No broken layout or empty space left where the button was

requirements.text: Remove the paragraph element (REQ XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[3]/p[1]) and the button element (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[3]/button[1]) from section 4 (likely the ServicesSection or a related section). Adjust surrounding layout to remain clean and smooth after removal.

quotes: Jo Jo select Kiya hai in sabko Remove kar do
website ko adjust aur smooth kar do

acceptanceCriteria: The paragraph and button in section 4's third column/card are no longer rendered
Section 4 layout adjusts gracefully with no orphaned empty containers or awkward spacing

requirements.text: Remove the logo text div from the header (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/header[1]/div[1]/div[1]/a[1]/div[2]) — this is the text label next to the logo image in the Header component. Keep the logo image/icon intact; only remove the text div.

quotes: Jo Jo select Kiya hai in sabko Remove kar do

acceptanceCriteria: The header logo text div is no longer visible
The header logo icon/image remains visible and the header layout stays balanced

requirements.text: Remove the entire card/container div (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]), including the inner content div (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]/div[1]) and anchor link (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[7]/div[1]/div[2]/div[3]/a[1]) from section 7 (likely ContactSection or FAQSection). Adjust the grid or flex layout of the parent container so remaining cards/items fill the space evenly.

quotes: Jo Jo select Kiya hai in sabko Remove kar do
website ko adjust aur smooth kar do

acceptanceCriteria: The third card/div in section 7's second row/column group is removed
Remaining cards in section 7 are evenly distributed without empty gaps
No layout breakage on mobile or desktop

requirements.text: Add a clearly visible Terms & Policy link in the website footer (Footer.tsx). The link should navigate to the /terms route. Place it in the navigation links area of the footer alongside existing footer links. Ensure it is styled consistently with other footer links.

quotes: terms and policy ka link website me bhi de do kahi pe dikh hi nahi Raha hai

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Terms & Policy' link is visible in the footer
The link is styled consistently with other footer navigation links
The link is visible on both mobile and desktop viewports

constraints: Only make the changes described in REQ-1 through REQ-5 — no other UI, logic, or style changes
Do not alter any immutable frontend paths (hooks, main.tsx, ui components)
Keep all other existing sections, components, and styles exactly as they are
nonGoals: Adding new sections or features beyond the specified changes
Changing color schemes, typography, or branding
Modifying the Terms page content itself
Adding Terms & Policy link in the header or any location other than the footer
